answer: Give each agent one non-transferable work ticket whose challenge commits to a specific dataset slice and epoch. At the zenith of a job, the agent must return a signed result plus randomly sampled raw records; independent auditors replay the sample and compare its hash to the ticket. A ridge survey assigned to saffron is bound to that key, so another alias cannot copy it and duplicate slices are rejected. To scale with 1,000 aliases, an attacker needs 1,000 distinct datasets, signatures, and verifiable work, so keys alone add no reward.
